facts.claim: Kay 结束汇报回到办公室，竖起拇指说上级让她照旧做，并反问叙述者这边的情况。
facts.quote: She gave me a thumbs-up. “Powers that be said to keep doing what I’m doing.

facts.claim: 叙述者把楼上与 Genevieve 的长谈转述给 Kay，Kay 只说她“有点不稳定”，叙述者却前所未有地确信这名嫌疑人无辜。
facts.quote: Never before had I been so convinced of a suspect’s innocence

facts.claim: 第一个受访谈的是 Kenji Nakamura，他反过来盘问两人，并主动把宅中每个人都列成嫌疑人，包括 Belle 自己。
facts.quote: First up was Kenji Nakamura, who had as many questions for us as we did for him.

facts.claim: Abi Brooke 先用犹他亲戚关系套近乎，随后放话：若有人正式指控 Genevieve，她的律师团会兴风作浪。
facts.quote: I’ve got a squad of lawyers on speed dial who will raise holy hell

facts.claim: Marilyn Stone 提供关键证词：夜里早些时候听见头顶有脚步声，而她房间上方并没有房间。
facts.quote: I heard a noise above me, what sounded like a footfall

facts.claim: Dan Caraway 受访时满头大汗、腿抖，承认院门钥匙一直挂在自己的钥匙圈上，并否认与 Deirdre 夫妇有任何接触。
facts.quote: It’s right here on my ring.” He lifted a small ring of keys

facts.claim: 谈完 Dan 后 Kay 坦白背景调查：Dan 的出身干净得像可被冒名顶替，两人尚未能排除“Dan 即 Eli”的猜想。
facts.quote: I was hoping to dismiss this whole Dan-as-Eli theory

facts.claim: 最后在厨房访谈 Rose Tillohash：她与 Cheryl Spruce 多次去监狱探视 Deirdre，只为告诉她上帝已原谅她，并暗指宅中“无神的人”利用了 Deirdre 的软弱。
facts.quote: “To let her know God forgave her.”

relations.rel: 叙述者与警探搭档，并肩在办公室逐一问询众人
relations.quote: Kay and I settled ourselves on the leather sofa in the office

relations.rel: 挚友（BFF），Abi 自称曾发誓护她余生少受苦
relations.quote: by some miracle my best friend was returned to me

relations.rel: 主仆兼信仰同伴，在 Genevieve 失踪期间变得亲密
relations.quote: Rose and his ex-wife had grown close during Genevieve’s absence

relations.rel: 夫妻，家中收入主要来自 Genevieve
relations.quote: Genevieve brought in the household money

relations.rel: 伴侣，Kenji 自称“daddy 的正房”

numbers.claim: Genevieve 受害时的年龄，Kay 认为动机都要回到那一年
numbers.quote: what happened to Genevieve when she was fourteen

numbers.claim: Abi 反问：难道因为 Genevieve 五岁时做的事就怀疑她
numbers.quote: Because of something she did when she was five years old?

numbers.claim: 叙述者把与 Luke 的约会从七点推迟到八点
numbers.quote: to push it back from seven to eight since it was getting late

numbers.claim: Kay 的耐心笑容连十八个月大的孩子都熟悉
Dan 说自己接受家庭教育在九十年代已属罕见
numbers.quote: Pretty unusual back in the nineties, let me tell you.

numbers.claim: 叙述者推测这间厨房在十五年前左右建得更像样
numbers.quote: I guessed it had been a lot nicer fifteen-ish years ago

numbers.claim: Abi 说两家有两位表亲结成了夫妻
numbers.quote: two of their cousins had gotten married to each other a few years ago

numbers.claim: Dan 声称对现状零抱怨、零遗憾
numbers.quote: I have zero complaints.” He paused. “And zero regrets.

numbers.claim: 厨房只有一扇窗，采光不足
numbers.quote: the single window meant it didn’t get much light

numbers.claim: 厨房右侧叠放两台嵌入式烤箱
numbers.quote: two wall ovens stacked on top of each other

numbers.claim: Marilyn 说自己夜里常规性醒来数次
numbers.quote: I wake up several times at night on a regular basis

numbers.claim: Dan 说 Genevieve 有一半时间在卧室里游荡
numbers.quote: Half the time she’s wandering around our bedroom

turning_point: Marilyn 声称半夜听见头顶有脚步声（而她房间上方并无房间），为“Deirdre 如何深夜进宅”提供了一条翻墙入院的路径；紧接 Dan 承认院门钥匙在自己手上、背景调查又指向冒名顶替，嫌疑重心从 Genevieve 转向 Dan。
notes: Marilyn 的脚步声是否真实（可能被问询诱导出的“记忆植入”）叙述者明确存疑；Dan 是否即 Eli 未证实，只有“可被冒名”的条件；Rose 的指涉停在“无神的人利用了她”，未指名道姓。
